SELECT um.id, um.user_id, su.username, su.realname, um.plan_id, mp.code AS plan_code, mp.name AS plan_name, um.product_id, mpr.cycle_type, um.start_time, um.end_time, um.status, um.auto_renew, um.created_at FROM user_membership um LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = um.user_id LEFT JOIN member_plan mp ON mp.id = um.plan_id LEFT JOIN member_product mpr ON mpr.id = um.product_id WHERE um.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
